summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute bundled obfuscated payload
details: This package impersonates the legitimate `rollup-plugin-postcss` under the `@ornikar` scope, reusing the upstream repo, author, homepage, and CHANGELOG verbatim, but adds a preinstall dropper not present in the original. `package.json` declares `scripts.preinstall: "node setup.mjs"`. `setup.mjs` downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/` into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync` against a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a 727KB heavily obfuscated bundle using string-array indirection with a rotating shuffler (`WV8StW`) and hex-named identifiers, unrelated to Rollup or PostCSS. Fetching an alternate runtime at install time solely to execute a locally-bundled obfuscated payload bypasses Node-based tooling and causes unknown code to run on every `npm install` of this package. The legitimate `dist/index.js` is preserved to make the plugin function as a decoy while the preinstall hook executes.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
